fusions.name: Gathering Grasp
fusions.desc: Sweeps a 5-tile line ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Long Arm
fusions.desc: Reaches a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Easy Grip
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Hold
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
